title: The Common Things
markdown:
在 Bilibili 观看: [https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1pN4UztEiQ](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1pN4UztEiQ) six frames, twenty seconds each voice and visuals transform the common
into something almost sacred under the metallic masks
the ordinary turns dreamlike a quiet meditation on identity, repetition,
and the beauty hidden in plain sight directed by Smart Chen voice-over narration by Luccas Perez special thanks to Franciscus Chang, Luccas Perez, Nathan Ren, Ian De Leon and Will Chen 10/2025 ![](notion-file-block://24a6109b-2d34-48ca-86bc-598a32438fbb/ada55db0-a1ce-4625-aec8-d19e1d18accf?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=2baa73166188100bf376.jpg) ![](notion-file-block://c501a53b-a893-4800-97b5-62c0264daf64/812da9a4-ee1f-41b3-9b4d-cdaed0405f56?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=35ca9ea57d809c3bac06.jpg) ![](notion-file-block://f3e18789-60ee-45cc-bfd2-91864052c061/e35d0c9a-ec01-42af-8a40-983d00487426?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=9828db1824da23e71bc1.jpg) ![](notion-file-block://6cd81f01-2119-4ceb-8994-4d9fcf24f3c8/45badeda-1929-4583-bf39-ca5801c6c70a?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=4f4c105162c69ca3074b.jpg) ![](notion-file-block://61c9a312-77fe-427b-8400-f0eb0ea7eb52/98d3b20b-40a7-4ded-88d1-e516bea3ccfa?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=2b8dacf5a539da9455f6.jpg) ![](notion-file-block://c71e7c05-6822-46c0-b2a5-2a52cb0058ec/748b7221-d8b5-41bd-9680-032d8c8b9a10?space_id=caeabc37-a86f-8101-a6fd-00033dd9a3dd&name=30b5e269cc10afcd8798.jpg) Luccas Perez: Then there’s me, Running, chasing It's always something Whether it was getting out of Broward Whether it was getting out of Atlantis Getting into college Getting to this music Connecting with my dead Trying to inspire my youngins Make a mannequin out of me It's always something But truly, it’s nothing I do more and more, and remain empty The pursuit of knowledge, power, money, fame, self-fulfillment, some sense of satisfaction, simply to be satiated- I am a husk, my hunger is unsatiable However, my resolve is ever unbreakable I don’t think I'll ever find what I’m chasing, and that’s okay
